logger.doc:name: Start Of Transaction
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { flow : "Start of flow : " ++ flow.name, message: flow.name ++" has Ended", correlationId: vars.correlationId }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "host": Mule::p('db.host'), "port": Mule::p('db.port'), "username": Mule::p('secure::db.username'), "password": Mule::p('secure::db.password'), "database": Mule::p('db.database') }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- "UPDATE Invoice SET Currency = :Currency, DetractionAmount = :DetractionAmount, DetractionPercent = :DetractionPercent, DueDate = :DueDate, InvoiceType = :InvoiceType, InvoiceDate = :InvoiceDate, OperationTypeCode = :OperationTypeCode, PaymentTerms = :PaymentTerms, PurchaseOrderNo = :PurchaseOrderNo, ReceptionDate = :ReceptionDate, status = :status, GrossAmount = :GrossAmount, customerAddressId = :customerAddressId, sellToVatId = :sellToVatId, source = :source WHERE InvoiceNumber = :InvoiceNumber"

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "Currency": vars.invoiceData.currency.code, "DetractionAmount": vars.invoiceData.detraction_amount, "DetractionPercent": vars.invoiceData.detraction_percentage, "DueDate": vars.invoiceData.due_date, // "InvoiceNumber": vars.invoiceData.id, "InvoiceType": vars.invoiceData.invoice_type, "InvoiceDate": vars.invoiceData.issue_date, "OperationTypeCode": vars.invoiceData.operation_type.code, "PaymentTerms": vars.invoiceData.payment_terms, "PurchaseOrderNo": vars.invoiceData.purchase_order.reference, "ReceptionDate": vars.invoiceData.reception_date, "InvoiceNumber": vars.invoiceData.sn, "status": vars.invoiceData.eval_status, "GrossAmount": vars.invoiceData.total, "customerAddressId": vars.invoiceData.bbss_code, "sellToVatId": vars.invoiceData.xml_supplier_ruc, "source": "Linka-CSI" }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- "SELECT id FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceNumber = :InvoiceNumber"

set-payload.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.invoiceData.extra_data map ((item, index) -> { "lineItemTotal": item.precio_venta_unitario, "quantity": item.cantidad, "itemCode": item.code default "", "description": item.descripcion, "lineNumber": item.orden, "priceWithTax": item.precio_venta, "unitOfMeasure": item.unidad_de_medida, "unitPrice": item.valor_unitario, "invoiceID": vars.existingInvoiceId[0].id })]
set-payload.doc:name: Invoice Detail Payload

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- "INSERT INTO InvoiceDetail(lineItemTotal,quantity,itemCode,description,lineNumber,priceWithTax,unitOfMeasure,unitPrice,invoiceID) VALUES(:lineItemTotal,:quantity,:itemCode,:description,:lineNumber,:priceWithTax,:unitOfMeasure,:unitPrice,:invoiceID)"

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "host": Mule::p('db.host'), "port": Mule::p('db.port'), "username": Mule::p('secure::db.username'), "password": Mule::p('secure::db.password'), "database": Mule::p('db.database') }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- "INSERT INTO Tax(taxAmount, invoiceDetailID) VALUES (:taxAmount, :invoiceDetailID)"

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "host": Mule::p('db.host'), "port": Mule::p('db.port'), "username": Mule::p('secure::db.username'), "password": Mule::p('secure::db.password'), "database": Mule::p('db.database') }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "taxAmount": (vars.invoiceData.extra_data.monto_igv)[vars.counter - 1], "invoiceDetailID": vars.invoiceDetailId["generatedKeys"]["GENERATED_KEYS"] as Number }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- "INSERT INTO DeliveryNote(NoteID, productCode, quantity, invoiceId) VALUES(:NoteID, :productCode, :quantity, :invoiceId)"

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "host": Mule::p('db.host'), "port": Mule::p('db.port'), "username": Mule::p('secure::db.username'), "password": Mule::p('secure::db.password'), "database": Mule::p('db.database') }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- flatten(vars.invoiceData.gres map ((item, index) -> (item.data.bienes map ((item1, index1) -> { "NoteID": item.id, "productCode": item1.codigo, "quantity": item1.cantidad, "invoiceId": vars.existingInvoiceId[0].id } ))))
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- "INSERT INTO InvoicePaymentPlan(paymentID, amountDue, invoiceId) VALUES(:paymentID, :amountDue, :invoiceId)"

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "host": Mule::p('db.host'), "port": Mule::p('db.port'), "username": Mule::p('secure::db.username'), "password": Mule::p('secure::db.password'), "database": Mule::p('db.database') }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.invoiceData.payment_data map ((item, index) -> { "dueDate": item.fecha_pago_cuota default "", "paymentID": item.id_cuota, "amountDue": item.monto_pendiente_pago, "invoiceId": vars.existingInvoiceId[0].id })

logger.doc:name: Log Invoice Payment Plan
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { "correlationId": vars.correlationId, "message": "Invoice Payment Plan Response", "response": payload }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- "INSERT INTO InvoiceRetention(retentionAmount,retentionPercent,invoiceId) VALUES(:retentionAmount,:retentionPercent,:invoiceId)"

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "host": Mule::p('db.host'), "port": Mule::p('db.port'), "username": Mule::p('secure::db.username'), "password": Mule::p('secure::db.password'), "database": Mule::p('db.database') }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "retentionAmount": vars.invoiceData.retention_data.importe_retencion , "retentionPercent": vars.invoiceData.retention_data.porcentaje_retencion, "invoiceId": vars.existingInvoiceId[0].id }

set-variable.doc:name: var : httpOperation

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- "INSERT INTO InvoiceFile(fileData,name,fileID,fileType, uploadDate, invoiceId) VALUES(:fileData, :name, :fileID, :fileType, :uploadDate, :invoiceId)"

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "host": Mule::p('db.host'), "port": Mule::p('db.port'), "username": Mule::p('secure::db.username'), "password": Mule::p('secure::db.password'), "database": Mule::p('db.database') }

logger.doc:name: No Files Received
